source.caption: Figure 12. Capacitance-voltage (C-V) measurements for (a) single layer ALD SiO2 films after annealing in forming gas (400 ◦ C, N2/H2, 10 min) and (b) for SiO2/Al2O3 stacks after annealing in N2 (400 ◦ C, 10 min). The SiO2 thickness was varied and the Al2O3 film thickness was 30 nm. The transients were measured using frequencies of 1, 10 (not shown) and 100 kHz. The C-V measurements were carried out several weeks after the annealing treatment. As substrates, 2 /Omega1 cm p -type c -Si wafers were used.
